messages:
emily: Heads-up: seeing slow drain on the taxiwave canary in eu-west-1, 3% traffic. tail latency creeping, small spike in 5xx. can we hold progress?

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary rollout started: taxiwave v2.2.0 -> 3% eu-west-1 at 1718801108. Health: partial OK, errors: 0.8% (baseline 0.1%), p99 latency +120ms.

ops-sarah: Thanks emily. Can you paste the short query from Grafana? link pls.
emily: https://monitoring.redwood/internal/d/abc123/taxiwave-canary — p50 ~ 60ms, p95 ~ 210ms, p99 ~ 540ms. 5xxs are concentrated on tokenizer shard 5.

raj: If tokenizer shard 5 is spiking, we should avoid increasing traffic until kv-cache eviction fix lands. +1 to holding.

marta: Agree. Propose: hold at 3%, pin routing for eu-west-1 to previous stable release v2.1.3 while we investigate. That minimizes user impact and keeps canary isolated.

jordan: Quick ask — does pinning affect the global change window? release notes already published for 2.2.0.

emily: Pinning is just a routing override, no change-window req. We will update release notes post-mitigation.

raj: Proposed pin command to run (ops execute):
```
redwood routing set --region eu-west-1 --service taxiwave --route-stable v2.1.3 --reason "hold due to p99 latency spike"
```

ops-sarah: I'll run that once we confirm runbook. Also want a rollback play if errors > 1.5% sustained for 5m. Marta — can you draft quick rollback steps?

marta: Rollback plan (short):
- pin region routing to v2.1.3 (as raj wrote)
- scale down new canary pods in eu-west-1 by 50%
- enable additional logging on tokenizer shard 5
- if errors >1.5% for 5m, full rollback: set global stable to v2.1.3 and abort canary rollouts in other regions.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Action queued: routing override request created #ROUTE-4823 by raj. Status: pending-approval.

emily: I approve the pin. exec ops when ready. I'll attach a short repro to the issue.

ops-sarah: Running routing set now. Will post status when done.

(30s later)
ops-sarah: done — routing pinned to v2.1.3 in eu-west-1. Verified user traffic for taxiwave in eu-west-1 is back on stable nodes. p99 dropped to baseline in ~40s. :white_check_mark:

emily: Nice. Leaving canary at 3% but drained; keep monitoring for tokenizer errors.

raj: Next steps: root cause on tokenizer shard 5 + look at memory/kv eviction. Assigning to infra/serving on the issue.

jordan: I'll update release-notes section: add note that 2.2.0 rollout paused in eu-west-1 due to latency and pinned to v2.1.3, will follow-up with RCA.

marta: I'll prepare rollback ops runbook in case we need full rollback. ETA 30m.

emily: Thanks all. For now — HOLD on any percent bump, no region rollouts. Ops will lift once infra confirms fix.

deploy-bot: deploybot: Canary status changed -> HOLD (3%) by ops-sarah at 1718801370.

jordan: ack. :thumbsup:

marta: added runbook to the ticket. assigning infra/serving @raj for follow-up.

emily: closing thread — will reopen if we need to cutover or rollback.
